eli: Heads up, promotion to prod blocked by CI failing at artifact publish step. checksum mismatch on layer abc123.
sasha: link?
eli: https://ci/internal/4901 logs show "unexpected EOF while reading tar" during multipart upload.
prudence: deploybot tried to promote but registry returned verify error. snippet: `deploybot: upload ok -> verify failed digest mismatch`
sre-bot: registry-east had elevated 5xxs 2024-01-15T08:42Z id r-33b. possible transient network drop.
sasha: can we cancel current promote and pin to last good tag (release-20240114)?
eli: yes please cancel. will open ticket REL-3398.
deploybot: cancel accepted for promote 4901. status: stopping after current chunk.
prudence: plan: 1) cancel promote 2) re-run push-stage 3) validate with skopeo locally 4) manual promote in next change window
sasha: kicked re-push job 4902, watching parts.
eli: updated release notes: "staging artifact upload transient failure; pinned to previous artifact pending safe re-upload"
sre-bot: registry 5xxs cleared, latency normalized.
sasha: re-push finished, skopeo inspect digest matches expected sha256:abc123def.
prudence: holding auto-promo until change window (17:00 UTC). ready for manual resume and smoke tests then.
eli: follow-up: add post-upload checksum verify step to CI to avoid marking success on truncated upload. filing PR.
